data.title: Update list and show commands to include additional types and statuses
data.description: The issue type "verify" and status "draft" were added to the schema. Ensure that issues with this type or status are shown when the `fleece list`, `fleece list --tree`, `fleece list --next` or `fleece show {id}` are run, as currently they do not seem to show up when the `verify` type is present.
